mutations.name: a shadow-scoped round counts as scoped
kills: review stats for scoped fix rounds stores a shadow-scoped fix round as full, so the first-scoped cutoff waits for a round whose brief was scoped

mutations.name: the corrected reply's check overwrites the first check's counts
kills: review stats for scoped fix rounds records the first scope check's counts on the correctness round, not the corrected reply's, and sums them per week
